title: iPhone free for 59 min while 1 job waits

messages.text:
The iPhone has had no holder for 59 min (since 01:09Z; released by int-v8). The limit is 5 min.
Waiting on the status board: pr-018-menu-morph (owner fix-hero-exit-threaded; its next step names the phone (unmarked)).
What unblocks it: the next of fix-hero-exit-threaded takes it (node tools/lock.mjs acquire iphone --owner <you> ...).
No steward on duty (mgmt-devices is parked): the lead handles this thread (I-175).
One message per idle period; this thread closes by itself when the slot is taken (tools/idle.mjs, I-105).

**Answer:** the idle was by design; the phone job could start only after my signature at 02:10Z.
- The GO went to fix-hero-exit-threaded; it takes the phone at its next step.
- I check again in a few minutes.
What you need to do: nothing.
